thread:
olivia (AE): Heads-up — VantageGrid has pushed the POC to exec review. CISO wants written confirmation on data residency + a one-sheet on our failover SLA. Asking for an exec briefing by EOW. :exclamation:
kevin (Solutions Eng): Got it. I can draft the one-sheet. quick Q on the POC topology — do they need private VPC peering or just region isolation?
priya (CS): VantageGrid mentioned they want traffic to remain in eu-west-1 and an allowlist for IPs. No peering initially, but they asked for a design doc for on-prem later.
kevin (Solutions Eng): Ok — I'll include region-only config and a note about on-prem options. Also need to confirm model variants for the demo (gpt-like vs quantized).
olivia (AE): Also price sensitivity — buyer asked if we can cap monthly overage for first 3 months. Could use an executive exception. @nathan can legal approve a capped overage clause?
nathan (Legal): I can do a limited amendment. Need exact language and the cap number. Also flag: customer requested mutual indemnity wording — that's going to the contracts playbook.
priya (CS): I'll pull the SSO/SAML questionnaire they filled out — there were 2 open items on key rotation and audit logs.
eva (Product): For failover SLA one-sheet: suggested text: "99.9% availability with automatic fallback to a compatible CPU-backed model variant in region for degraded GPU capacity". Thoughts?
kevin (Solutions Eng): That phrasing works. Add: "latency targets may vary during fallback; we provide detailed telemetry and per-route tracing."
olivia (AE): Can we get an internal exec briefing this week? Customer wants CRO to join. I can set the time if we confirm attendees. Need slides + legal sign-off on amendment before briefing.
nathan (Legal): I can turn around a draft amendment in 48 hrs if you give me the cap and whether the cap applies to token usage only or total bill.
priya (CS): Cap should be token usage only — they care about inference bill spikes. I'll ask VantageGrid to confirm number and get back by tomorrow morning.
kevin (Solutions Eng): I'll drop a short POC topology diagram and the one-sheet into the shared drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/vantagegrid-poc
olivia (AE): Great. If we can get the amendment + slides by Thurs AM, I can get the CRO on a Fri 9am EMEA slot.
eva (Product): I'll review the one-sheet and add a short note on fallback model identities and expected perf delta (+/- p50 latency).
priya (CS): Sending the SSO questionnaire highlights now. Also pinging the customer for the overage cap this morning.
kevin (Solutions Eng): quick snippet for the one-sheet pricing example:
```
Baseline: 200k tokens/month included
Overage cap (request): $5,000/month (tokens overage)
```
Add legal caveat for change after trial.
olivia (AE): @nathan once you have the amendment draft pls ping me. Also flagging this as an executive escalation — may need @katie (CRO) on the briefing depending on legal timeline. :eyes: 
nathan (Legal): Will do. If customer confirms cap today I should have draft by tomorrow EOD. If not, aim for 48 hrs after confirmation.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: "VantageGrid Exec Briefing" Fri 09:00 EMEA — calendar invite sent to olivia, kevin, priya, nathan, eva
olivia (AE): Thanks team. Tracker for next steps: 1) Priya confirm cap with customer (ETA: tomorrow AM) 2) Kevin -> one-sheet + diagram (ETA: Wed EOD) 3) Nathan -> amendment draft (ETA: 48h after cap confirmed) 4) Eva -> SLA perf note (ETA: Thu AM) 5) Olivia -> finalize briefing agenda + CRO invite (ETA: Thu AM). I'll update thread as items complete. :thumbsup:
